summary: Implemented `runstat compare`: src/runstat/compare.py computes and renders both runs' signals side by side with a delta column, reusing signals.py's compute_signals/format_value rather than recomputing them, wired into __main__.py's `compare` subcommand.
verified: uv run runstat compare tests/fixtures/runs/20260814-101500 tests/fixtures/runs/20260815-090000, checked against T6's own verify regexes (all matched) and against the gates for T1, T3, T4 and T5 (all still exit 0); no test suite exists yet (T8 not yet run) so `uv run pytest -q` reports no tests ran, matching the state T1 left it in.
notes: Delta rule: tasks closed is non-numeric so always blank; iterations per closed and estimated spend use Python's `{:+.2f}` / manual sign to get an explicit leading '+' on positive deltas; the four plain-int signals (iterations, gate failures, review rejections, attempts burned, no-progress streak) get '+N'/'-N'/'0' via a small helper since Python's '+d' format spec would print '+0' for a zero delta, which the brief's 'explicit + when positive' wording doesn't ask for. compute_comparison also treats a None value on either side (the n/a case for iterations-per-closed with zero tasks closed) as a blank delta, same as a string value, even though no fixture exercises it. Table columns are fixed-width text (label 22, values right-aligned 10) — not pinned by the brief, only that each line carries label/valueA/valueB/delta in that order.
